inputs.name: triage.json

steps.name: tickets
steps.command:
jq -c '.[]' tickets.json \
    | thinkthen annotate triage.json --jsonl --field /body --jobs 16 --details \
    | jq -c '.input + .value | del(.body)'

steps.name: tickets-again
steps.command:
jq -c '.[]' tickets.json \
    | thinkthen annotate triage.json --jsonl --field /body --jobs 16 --details \
    | jq -c '{id: .input.id, cached: .meta.cached, requests_sent: .meta.requests_sent}'

inputs.name: change.diff
inputs.text:
diff --git a/billing.py b/billing.py
--- a/billing.py
+++ b/billing.py
@@ -3,2 +3,2 @@ def late_fee(days):
-    # charge a fee after 30 days
+    # Charge a fee after 30 days.
     if days > 30:
@@ -8,2 +8,2 @@ def refund(amount, limit):
-    if amount > limit:
+    if amount >= limit:
         return False
@@ -14,3 +14,3 @@ def total(items):
-    t = 0
-    for i in items: t += i.price
-    return t
+    subtotal = 0
+    for item in items: subtotal += item.price
+    return subtotal
@@ -20,1 +20,1 @@ def tax(amount):
-    return amount * 0.07
+    return round(amount * 0.07, 2)

inputs.name: hunks.jq

steps.name: diff
steps.command:
jq -cRnf hunks.jq change.diff \
    | thinkthen decide 'Does this change what the code does when it runs?' \
        --jsonl --field /hunk --details \
    | jq -c '{file: .input.file, at: .input.at, changes: .value}'

inputs.name: draft.txt
inputs.text:
The export runs every night at two.
It might possibly be worth considering a retry.
Failed rows go to a separate file.
We think this should probably work for most users.
Each row keeps its id.

steps.name: lint
steps.command:
jq -cR '{line: input_line_number, text: .}' draft.txt \
    | thinkthen filter 'Does this sentence hedge?' --jsonl --field /text \
    | jq -r '"draft.txt:\(.line): \(.text)"'
steps.output:
draft.txt:2: It might possibly be worth considering a retry.
draft.txt:4: We think this should probably work for most users.
